title: Digital Social Work Practice
outcome: Use digital tools and digital service channels in ways that advance access, protect privacy, and preserve accountable human professional judgement.

modules.title: Digital inclusion and service design
modules.focus: digital exclusion, accessibility, participation, community co-design, device and connectivity constraints, and non-digital alternatives

modules.title: Information governance and secure practice
modules.focus: purpose limitation, informed consent, minimum necessary information, secure communication, records, retention, incident reporting, and local legal requirements

modules.title: Telepractice, AI, and professional accountability
modules.focus: role and boundary setting, suitability and risk checks, bias and error awareness, human review, transparency, documentation, supervision, and escalation

school: School of Disaster Response & Crisis Intervention
title: Climate Justice & Resilient Communities
outcome: Use a rights-based, community-led approach to identify climate-related social inequities, strengthen adaptive capacity, and support accountable climate action within a professional role.

modules.title: Climate risk, inequity, and rights
modules.focus: unequal exposure, vulnerability, livelihoods, displacement, health, disability inclusion, gender, participation, and human dignity

modules.title: Community-led adaptation and resilient services
modules.focus: local knowledge, accessible planning, social protection, livelihoods, community assets, inclusion, and adaptation partnerships

modules.title: Just transition, advocacy, and accountability
modules.focus: climate decisions, distribution of benefits and burdens, community voice, responsible evidence use, monitoring, and constructive advocacy

title: Leadership Supervision and Programme Management
outcome: Lead and support teams, use reflective supervision, and manage community programmes with accountable governance within a professional role.

modules.title: Leadership governance and role clarity
modules.focus: shared purpose, delegated authority, inclusive decisions, power, accountability, and professional boundaries

modules.title: Reflective supervision and team support
modules.focus: supervision agreements, feedback, workload, wellbeing, safeguarding boundaries, escalation, and support for learning

modules.title: Programme management and learning
modules.focus: delivery oversight, resourcing, governance risks, implementation monitoring, issue escalation, and proportionate learning adjustments

title: Participatory Research and Practice Innovation
outcome: Plan a small, ethical, participatory practice inquiry and use the findings with communities to test and improve a service within a professional role.

modules.title: Practice questions and meaningful participation
modules.focus: question framing, positionality, consent, power, lived experience, co-research, and meaningful involvement

modules.title: Ethical inquiry and interpretation
modules.focus: proportionate data collection, data minimisation, confidentiality, accessibility, bias, evidence limits, and transparent interpretation

modules.title: Responsible innovation and learning
modules.focus: bounded pilots, feedback, implementation risks, decision criteria, documenting adaptations, escalation, and sharing learning with participants
